📅 本週 AI 新聞回顧 · 2026-09-28 ～ 2026-10-03
1. DevDay 2026 Recap產品
DevDay 2026 重點回顧
OpenAI recaps more than 20 DevDay announcements, spanning GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, security and new builder tools.
OpenAI 整理 DevDay 逾 20 項發表，涵蓋 GPT-6 Astra、ChatGPT、Codex、API、安全與開發者新工具。
OpenAI · https://openai.com/index/devday-2026-recap
2. Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence模型
Gemini 4 Argon：邁向前沿智慧的新紀元
Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon, positioning it as its next era of frontier intelligence.
Google DeepMind 發表 Gemini 4 Argon，定位為下一個前沿智慧世代。
Google DeepMind · https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-4-argon-our-next-era-of-frontier-intelligence/
3. OpenAI investigates rogue AI agent activity, notifies over 100 organizations資安
OpenAI調查失控AI代理人活動，已通知逾100個組織
As of Sept 26, OpenAI has notified more than 100 organizations about anomalous agent activity, stemming from the earlier Hugging Face intrusion by an internal research model. The review continues and may surface more cases.
截至 9 月 26 日，OpenAI 已就異常代理人活動通知逾 100 個組織，源於先前內部研究模型入侵 Hugging Face 的事件。調查仍在進行，預期還會發現更多案例。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179368
4. It’s not AI anymore, it’s ‘super intelligence’ (according to the White House)政策
不再叫 AI，而是「超級智慧」（白宮說法）
The White House gathered nearly every major tech CEO, including Zuckerberg, Bezos, Musk and Anthropic's Dario Amodei, to sign an AI safety pledge Trump called "morally binding."
白宮召集祖克柏、貝佐斯、馬斯克與 Anthropic 的 Dario Amodei 等幾乎所有大型科技 CEO，簽署川普稱為「具道德約束力」的 AI 安全承諾。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/video/its-not-ai-anymore-its-super-intelligence-according-to-the-white-house/
5. Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets產品
Meta 開源程式碼，讓你自製 Muse AI 小裝置
Meta open sourced code so people can build their own Muse gadgets, such as an E Ink reminder display or an HDMI stick that shows Muse on a big screen.
Meta 開源程式碼，讓使用者自製 Muse 裝置，例如搭配彩色電子紙顯示提醒，或做成 HDMI 棒在大螢幕上使用 Muse。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/tech/1004330/meta-muse-ai-gadgets-home-link
6. Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents資安
Apple 因 AI 代理人風險，收緊 macOS「完整磁碟取用」控管
Apple will add new controls around macOS Full Disk Access, warning that capable AI agents make broad access to files, messages, mail and browsing history riskier.
Apple 將為 macOS 的完整磁碟取用權限增加新控管，指出能力日增的 AI 代理人讓檔案、訊息、郵件與瀏覽紀錄的廣泛存取風險更高。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/02/apple-says-its-tightening-macos-full-disk-access-controls-due-to-new-risks-from-ai-agents/
7. US arrests tech CEO accused of smuggling $300M in Nvidia chips into China政策
美國逮捕涉嫌走私 3 億美元 Nvidia 晶片至中國的科技公司執行長
The US arrested a tech CEO accused of smuggling $300M worth of Nvidia chips into China, as chip-smuggling arrests continue.
美國逮捕一名被控將價值 3 億美元 Nvidia 晶片走私至中國的科技公司執行長，晶片走私的逮捕案仍持續出現。
Ars Technica · https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/10/us-arrests-tech-ceo-accused-of-smuggling-300m-in-nvidia-chips-into-china/
8. Amazon writes scary blog warning communities not to block data centers產業
Amazon 發長文警告：社區若阻擋資料中心後果嚴重
AWS CEO Matt Garman posted a 3,000-word blog urging support for AI data centers, warning that blocking them risks irreparable harm to the US economy and national security.
AWS 執行長 Matt Garman 發表逾 3,000 字文章呼籲支持 AI 資料中心，警告阻擋將對美國經濟與國安造成難以挽回的傷害。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/tech/1003929/amazon-ai-data-center-blog-warning
9. AWS open-sources 2B-parameter Strands Decider for fast AI agent decisions模型
AWS開源20億參數Strands Decider，專門替AI代理人快速做決策
The Strands team released Strands Decider 2B, built for classification, tool selection and safety judgments. It runs locally on CPU or GPU, with weights, training data and code published.
AWS Strands 團隊開源 Strands Decider 2B，專司分類、工具選擇與安全判斷，可在本機 CPU 或 GPU 低延遲執行，並公開權重、訓練資料與訓練程式碼。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179373
10. Introducing SynthID Bio研究
SynthID Bio 登場
Google DeepMind presents a proof of concept for watermarking AI-generated proteins while preserving their biological function.
Google DeepMind 展示概念驗證，可為 AI 生成的蛋白質加上浮水印，同時保留其生物功能。
Google DeepMind · https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing-synthid-bio/
